responsibilities: Manage and resolve operational/support data tickets (typically around 20 tickets per week, depending on sprint volume).
Perform end-to-end spike analysis on incoming queries and data discrepancies using SQL.
Proactively identify data inconsistencies and implement fixes to ensure accurate, reliable data delivery.
Group, prioritize, test, and deploy fixes efficiently within weekly sprint cycles.
Build and maintain tailored data models using dbt specifically for retail clients (focused on retailer-specific models rather than global architecture).
Filter and make sense of complex dataset noise to surface actionable business insights.
Work on analytical tasks at scale, ensuring high data fidelity on behalf of clients.
Participate in daily stand-ups to align on ticket distribution, priorities, and accurate delivery timelines.
Collaborate with the broader Data Engineering team (who handle core underlying pipeline architecture).
